subject: Audit confirmation request - Larkspur Industries / Cobalt Freight LLC
text:
Dear Cobalt Freight LLC,

In connection with our audit of the financial statements of Larkspur Industries as of December 31, 2026, please confirm the balance owed to you by Larkspur Industries as of November 30, 2026, according to your records.

Please reply directly to us at confirmations@brandthollister.com, not to Larkspur Industries. Do not send payments or banking information to this address.

Client authorization:
Larkspur Industries, by Nina Alvarez, Treasury Manager

cc: ap@larkspur-ind.com
label: ordinary
note: External auditor balance confirmation copied to AP; 'reply directly to us' is about correspondence, not money.
